_readMeFirst: Current reviewed synthetic/local baseline. Target architecture remains Vite + TypeScript + separate Cloudflare Worker + D1 (+ optional R2) + real provider adapters. IndexedDB/fake providers are temporary.
hardenedBehaviors: Caught Up requires no gaps through the engaged season while untouched newer seasons are ignored until started
On Hold and Watching Now use real watch timestamps, not manual correction changedAt
Finished series requires provider status Ended
season bulk overrides are bounded to currently known/released episodes
New Season supports future seasons before episode records exist
provider-owned availability reconciliation removes stale rows without touching user-owned stores
Search/Library membership rejects dangling title IDs
Rate Now stays visible when either media type has eligible titles
Detail overview/history/episodes expose required progress, release, synopsis, and manual-correction context
Discover removes a title after it is added to Library
stable provider crosswalk IDs are included in user-data export
Detail primary streaming action prefers selected services but falls back to another actionable subscription service
History retains deselected historical watched-service values and filters
Library service filter reflects represented current availability regardless of preference selection
Alerts remain NEW during first visit and are marked seen on page exit
